desc:
*Expect some bugs*

Inspired by the short film Remain Calm.

You’re stuck on the night shift at a lonely gas station, and something is out there in the dark. You must complete all your duties and survive until sunrise. 

Survive the night:
🔦 Do you tasks around the store 
🧟 Hide, run and stay relaxed. The monster is only dangerous when your heartrate rises
📦 Buy supplies at the Containment Response truck to help you 
🤝 Team up with friends, or try to make it to sunrise alone


All credit goes to The Lewis Brothers and Pauly Shore for the inspiration on this project
